paragraph_text: The Beneficiary satisfies 8 C.F.R. §204.5(h)(3)(i) by demonstrating receipt of nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field. The Beneficiary was selected as a scholar of Beijing's 'Hundred People Project,' a prestigious talent recognition program that identifies and supports exceptional academics in the capital region [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This selection demonstrates that the Beneficiary's scholarly work has been recognized at the highest levels of academic evaluation in China, as the 'Hundred People Project' specifically targets leading researchers for special support and recognition [Exhibit A1, p.2]. The program's rigorous selection process ensures that only the most accomplished scholars receive this designation, placing the Beneficiary among an elite group of academic leaders in Beijing [Exhibit A1, p.2]. Furthermore, the Beneficiary's work 'On Age' won the third prize of Outstanding Achievements in Humanities and Social Sciences of the Ministry of Education of China, a nationally recognized award established by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China in 2009 [Exhibit A1, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.2, p.4]. This award is administered by the Ministry of Education through a formal Award Committee composed of directors, deputy directors of the Social Sciences Committee, and heads of relevant departments, with evaluation conducted by a committee of experts selected from across the country based on high academic attainments [Exhibit B10, p.5]. The award recognizes outstanding contributions in humanities and social sciences research and is selected only every three years, with all awards divided into grand prizes, first prizes, second prizes, and third prizes, making the Beneficiary's third prize a significant achievement in this highly competitive national competition [Exhibit B10, p.4, p.5]. The evaluation criteria require that awarded results adhere to Marxism as the guide, have clear viewpoints, sufficient arguments, informative information, accurate data, strict logic, scientific methods, be innovative and cutting-edge, and conform to academic ethics and academic norms, demonstrating the rigorous standards the Beneficiary's work met [Exhibit B10, p.6]. In addition to the above, the Beneficiary received the Data Awards Data Legacy of the Year Award in 2019, which is pronounced the same as 'beacon' in Chinese and is one of the most influential awards in the field of mobile Internet [Exhibit B1, p.2; Exhibit B3, p.2, p.3]. This award was jointly launched by Umen+, Zhongguancun Big Data Industry Alliance, Tsingdata Big Data Industries Association, and China Big Data Industry Observation, with the first 'Data Awards' in 2019 inviting a jury of 21 judges from dozens of authorities and industry experts and scholars including China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, Tsinghua University, and Peking University [Exhibit B3, p.3]. Through the development of professional selection models, seven categories of Data Awards finally emerged, with a total of 40 Data enterprises and 28 Data individuals standing out from what was undoubtedly a much larger pool of candidates, making the Beneficiary's recognition as one of only 28 individual winners a significant achievement [Exhibit B3, p.4]. The Data Legacy of the Year Award specifically recognizes individuals who have been working deeply in the field of big data and mobile Internet for many years, spreading their insights and experiences and educating the whole industry, and who lead many Internet practitioners to continuously inherit data application, industry methodology, and scientific research [Exhibit B3, p.7]. Moreover, the Beneficiary's paper titled 'Challenges Posed by the Internet to Traditional Media in the Time Dimension - A Study on the Possibility of Internet Media Usage Time Surpassing Traditional Media Usage Time' won the Excellent Paper Award at the 11th China Communication Conference, as certified by the Communication Association of China and The 11th China Communication Conference Organizing Committee [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This recognition at a major national communication conference demonstrates that the Beneficiary's research has been evaluated and honored by leading professional organizations in the field of communication studies in China [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The certificate was issued by the Communication Association of China, the premier professional organization for communication studies in the country, further establishing the prestige and national recognition of this award [Exhibit B11, p.2]. Additionally, the Beneficiary's affiliated organization, Umen+, has received multiple industry recognitions including being named an Enterprise Service High-growth Company by 36 Kr and receiving the China Big Data Industry Application TOP Choice designation in Three Major Fields, demonstrating the caliber of institutions with which the Beneficiary is associated [Exhibit B4, p.4]. Umen+ has also been recognized as a 2019 China Big Data Innovative Enterprises TOP 100 company by the Data Technology Industry Innovation Institute (DTiii) and received the 2018 Excellent Team Award of Internet Security Management from the Chaoyang Public Security Branch Network Security Guarding Brigade, further establishing its standing in the industry [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These enterprise-level awards complement the Beneficiary's individual recognitions and demonstrate that the Beneficiary operates within organizations that are themselves recognized as leaders in their respective fields, further validating the Beneficiary's professional standing [Exhibit B4, p.4]. In sum, the foregoing evidence clearly establishes that the Beneficiary has received nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field.
